title: [review] messaging.py:145: Inconsistent max_messages limi
description: Sent messages trimming uses the global constant `_MESSAGES_MAX` (100) instead of `self._max_messages`. If MessagesResource is created with max_messages=50, the inbox respects this limit but sent messages still uses 100. Line 86 correctly uses `self._max_messages` for inbox, but line 145 uses `_MESSAGES_MAX` directly.
close_reason: Fixed: Changed sent messages trimming to use self._max_messages instead of _MESSAGES_MAX constant. Also fixed docstring for deliver() method.
